retrieval_call_accounting_correction.reason: The earlier call count included a duplicate retrieval of the unchanged full query as if it were a separate clause on queries without relation connectors. Deduplicating it preserves rankings and removes redundant offline retrieval calls.

decision: Keep secondary intents as diagnostic metadata. Do not automatically add secondary-intent clauses to retrieval.
limitations: Lexical TF-IDF replica, not dense retrieval.
Development-only exploratory ablation; not a release gate.
Secondary-intent clause extraction is heuristic and can introduce off-topic evidence.
Retrieval call counts are offline function invocations, not hosted latency or cost measurements.
No holdout, database, LLM, staging or production runtime, publishing, or deployment was used.
